headline: New Zealand Dollar Hits 17-Year Low Against Trade-Weighted Index
summary: The New Zealand dollar declined to a 17-year low measured against the trade-weighted currency index.
why: The trade-weighted index measures the value of a currency against a basket of currencies of its major trading partners.

impacts.name: New Zealand Dollar
impacts.why: The New Zealand dollar dropped to a 17-year low against its trade-weighted index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Economic adjustments and trade developments pushed the New Zealand dollar to multi-year lows against partner currencies.
